_about: Every piece of work AMV does without a person waiting on it: how it is started, which file owns it, and what happens when it fails. tests/worker/every-background-duty-has-an-owner checks this against the scheduled handler and the queue consumer (Nov 1 audit TASK-004).

minute.what: background jobs that are due now (quick pass over the due-hour index)
minute.retry: a failed run is retried up to three times inside the run with backoff; five failed runs switch the job off; the queue path retries with a growing delay and dead-letters after its max

reconcile.retry: idempotent by event id; the next tick re-reads what failed

outbox.retry: each message carries its own attempt count and next time; given up after three days, never resent twice (idempotency key to the mail provider)

digest.retry: once per account per week (claim); a failed send goes to the outbox

renewals.retry: cursor-based sweep, resumed from the cursor next tick; each account claimed once per period

backup.what: the nightly backup, a slice at a time
backup.retry: under a lease; each part checksummed; an unfinished night continues next tick

agentjar.what: deleting agent sign-ins whose deletion could not be confirmed
agentjar.retry: the pending list is retried every tick until each delete is read back

retention.what: deleting conversations past their chosen retention
retention.retry: under a lease, a slice at a time, resumed from the index

pgintent.what: Postgres writes whose mirror did not confirm
pgintent.retry: an intent older than five minutes becomes a repair entry; repairs never expire

pgbackfill.what: copying and checking KV records into Postgres
pgbackfill.retry: under a lease, cursor saved with each slice, mismatches kept as repair entries

batches.retry: a stale running item is reported, never re-run - it may have been charged

cohort.what: the heavy-user share check for the owner
cohort.retry: a measurement; the next tick recomputes it

slo.what: measuring the service objectives and telling the owner when one is over budget
slo.retry: once an hour behind a flag; a failed check is reported and the next hour runs it again; each broken objective is said once a day

synthetics.what: each configured capability doing one real, harmless operation, kept for readiness
synthetics.retry: its own hourly trigger (17 * * * *); a run that fails is reported and readiness shows the last result as stale after two hours; each failing capability is told once a day

erasures.what: finishing account deletions that left something behind
erasures.retry: a few each five-minute tick; each kept note counts its tries, and the owner is told after twelve

auto.retry: retried with a growing delay; after the queue's max retries it goes to the dead-letter queue, and a job dead-lettered twice in a day is quarantined until an operator releases it

outbox.retry: retried in five minutes; dead-lettered messages are acknowledged and recorded, the cron outbox still holds them
